name: Hidamari Color by Haruka Koharu
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
This recipe was design to create the impression of being wrapped in soft, gentle, warm sunlight. I created it so that this one recipe could be used for a variety of scenes and situations, including blue skies, cloudy days, and sunsets. It is particularly good for photographing flowers, natural scenery, and colorful buildings. Colors have been fine-tuned to allow you to enjoy a unique world from the moment you look through the viewfinder. Try adjusting exposure and white balance to suit your preferences and discover your favorite style.
